To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

progress toward motive incongrent goals, in contrast with progress toward motive congruence goals, accounted for interindividual differences (Study 1) and intraindividual changes (Study 2) in emotional well being.

the pursuit of personal motives accounts for interindividual variability in emotional well being, and that motive dispositions moderate the extent to which goal attributes are associated with emotional well being.

(1) the pursuit of personal goal congruent with one's motive dispositions is associated with greater emotional well being than the pursuit of personal, goal incongruent with one's motives, and (2) the pursuit of high commitment and high attainability personal goals that are congruent with one’s motives is associated with increased emotional well being over time
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of motive dispostions in determining the extent of the association between the pursuit of goals and emotional well-being.
the role of motive dispostions in determining the extent of the relation between personal goal pursuit and emotional well being.
the role that personal goals and motive dispositions play in the experience of emotional well being.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a person's motive dispositions are a crucial moderator in determining the impact of goal attributes and progress toward goals on emotional well being.

the more a person's goals are congruent with their personal needs, and the more they feel committed to those goals, and the more progress they make toward them, the better they will feel about their lives.
the pursuit of personal goal congruence is a necessary but not sufficient condition for emotional well being.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
people who have a strong desire to achieve their goals, but who also have goals that are congruent with their motives, are more emotionally well adjusted than those who do not have such goals.
the pursuit of personal goal is an important determinant of emotional well being, but that the extent to which this is so depends on motive dispositions.
the pursuit of personal agency and communion goals is a significant determinant of students' emotional well-being.
The main takeaway from our work is that
people's motives and goals matter in the pursuit of emotional well being and that these two factors should be considered in tandem.
people who pursue goals that are congruent with their motives are more likely to experience emotional well being.
the pursuit of personal goal accounts for individual differences in emotional well-being.
